replies.author: Subscriptor
replies.body:
Ayyy paco :)
I think that the monuments when theyre close to spawn it wil lead to the map being one of these quickly rushed and fast matches. You could try moving the monuments to the island in front of their current location. Also try to think of a way to make the middle control worthy. I assume its a flat island, try to make a gapple spawner or something like that. 
Aesthetics are great, and i gave the feedback about gameplay.

(Its Eric and long time no see, id like to keep skyping you and TS <3)
